description: This file contains unit tests for the DeepElementAdded class in a GStreamer-based media player project. It tests the behavior of the class when handling GStreamer elements, including callback registration, element type detection, and updating the player context.

classes.name: DeepElementAddedTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing DeepElementAdded behavior.

methods.name: shouldNotRegisterCallbackWhenPtrsAreNotEqual
methods.description: Tests that no callback is registered when the parent objects of the elements are not equal.

methods.name: shouldNotRegisterCallbackWhenElementIsNull
methods.description: Tests behavior when the element's name cannot be retrieved (null).

methods.name: shouldNotRegisterCallbackWhenElementNameIsNotTypefind
methods.description: Tests that no callback is registered if the element's name does not contain 'typefind'.

methods.name: shouldRegisterCallbackForTypefindElement
methods.description: Tests registration of a callback when the element's name contains 'typefind'.

methods.name: shouldUpdatePlaybackGroupWhenCallbackIsCalled
methods.description: Verifies that the playback group is updated correctly when the callback is invoked.

methods.name: shouldAddSignalIdOfRegisteredCallbackToPlayerContext
methods.description: Checks that the signal ID of the registered callback is stored in the player context.

methods.name: shouldAssignPipelineOnlyWhenElementNameIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that the pipeline is assigned only if the element's name is null.

methods.name: shouldDetectParseElement
methods.description: Tests detection of a 'parse' element and updates the context accordingly.

methods.name: shouldDetectDecElement
methods.description: Tests detection of a 'dec' element and updates the context accordingly.

methods.name: shouldDoNothingForNotHandledElementName
methods.description: Verifies that no action is taken for unrecognized element names.

methods.name: shouldDoNothingWhenAudiosinkParentNameIsNull
methods.description: Tests behavior when the parent of an 'audiosink' element has a null name.

methods.name: shouldDoNothingWhenAudiosinkParentIsNotBin
methods.description: Tests behavior when the parent of an 'audiosink' element is not a bin.

methods.name: shouldFindAudioSinkBin
methods.description: Tests detection of an 'audiosink' element with a parent bin named 'audiosinkbin'.
